title: Personnel.
bodyText: The director of health may hire such necessary personnel to carry out the purposes of this part in accordance with chapter 76.
bodyHtml: [§321-197]  Personnel.  The director of health may hire such necessary personnel to carry out the purposes of this part in accordance with chapter 76. [L 1975, c 190, pt of §2; am L 2000, c 253, §150]
